annotations.title: TRON dApps, exchanges, wallets and services

description: Ranked TronOrb directory: dApps by TVL on TRON, centralized exchanges by TRON reserves, wallets, and services (energy rental, exchangers, payment gateways, bots, explorers). Optionally filter by category (e.g. "DEX", "Lending", "Energy Rental"). Use it to browse or rank a whole section; to find one project by name use search_tronorb. Each entry has name, category, tagline, website and its TronOrb page; dapps and exchanges also get TVL or reserves with 7- and 30-day change (wallets and services have no metric and are ordered by listing date). Rankings refresh hourly. Returns an empty list for an unknown category.

category.description: Optional category name, e.g. "DEX", "Lending", "Energy Rental", "Payment Gateway"

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return, highest ranked first

type.description: Directory section: dapps (ranked by TVL), exchanges (by TRON reserves), wallets or services
